snippet.title: The Spirit Lift - Official Gameplay Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for The Spirit Lift, a roguelike spooky deckbuilder developed by prettysmart games. Players will explore an ever-changing retro hotel from the perspectives of teenagers from the 90's. Build a strong deck and face monstrosities in The Spirit Life, coming soon to PC (Steam).
